text:
maria.g: Heads up — we need final assets + copy for the launch posts this week. X and LinkedIn scheduling windows are tight.

jamal: Thanks — timeline?

maria.g: Target publish windows: X -> 2026-03-25 09:00 PT, LinkedIn -> 2026-03-25 11:00 PT. Need hero images, short copy (2 variants), 1-thread outline for X, and UTM links.

kevin: I can do the UTM strings. Which campaign names?

maria.g: Use campaign=redwood-launch, source=x or li, medium=social. Example: `?utm_campaign=redwood-launch&utm_source=x&utm_medium=social`

alia: Design checklist incoming. Quick Q: do we want 16:9 hero plus a square for carousel?

maria.g: Yes to both. Also request a 30s clip from the product team for socials.

sophia: I have a clip but it's 45s — can edit to 30s. Who owns messaging for the LinkedIn post?

jamal: I'll take LinkedIn. Drafts: Variant A — product-first (short), Variant B — benchmark-first (call out latency/cost).

maria.g: For X thread: 4 tweets max. Outline: 1) hook stat, 2) what we built, 3) quick benchmark result, 4) CTA to webinar. Jamal — can you draft the thread?

jamal: On it. Will post first draft by EOD.

kevin: Who's monitoring replies + DMs after publish? We should assign for the first 3 hours.

maria.g: Kevin and Alia for hour 0-3 PT, Sophia covers hour 3-6 PT. Add a follow-up message for high-intent replies with link to demo/webinar sign-up.

alia: Design request posted: `#assets/redwood-launch` — please add source files and export PNG/JPG + MP4 30s. Need final by 2026-03-24 16:00 PT.

scheduler-bot: Reminder scheduled — draft due 2026-03-24 12:00 PT, assets due 2026-03-24 16:00 PT, publish 2026-03-25 09:00 PT (X).

maria.g: Also: we need 3 follow-up micro-posts across week 1: benchmarks deep-dive, customer quote, webinar replay. Put them in the content calendar.

kevin: I'll add UTMs for the follow-ups: `utm_term=bench1` etc.

jamal: Draft thread posted in the folder: `/marketing/content/launch/1926789012-jamal-thread-v1.md` — feedback welcome.

alia: Quick ask for copy length: keep LinkedIn under 300 chars for boost eligibility.

maria.g: Correct. And tag speakers as `@` on LinkedIn post only after assets are final.

sophia: I'll prepare comment templates for engagement follow-ups (short replies, link to demo).

kevin: Everything looks good. Confirming: assets + clip by 3/24 16:00, copy drafts by 3/24 12:00, final schedule set 3/24 18:00 PT.

maria.g: Perfect. If anything slips, call it out in this thread with scheduler-bot tag so we can re-run windows. :thumbsup:

alia: Noted. Adding checklist to the calendar invite.

jamal: Posting copy v1 now. Feedback in thread, please.

sophia: Got it — will prepare engagement rota for launch day.

maria.g: Thank you all — let's land this.
